levels.label: train on tracks
levels.description: no skill needed, the effect unfolds regardless of where you put your attention

levels.label: canoe
levels.description: moderate skill rewarded, forgiving of a wobble

levels.label: surfboard
levels.description: high skill required, poor steering and you wipe out

levels.label: blended (2nd)
levels.description: a part takes over and its feelings become your reality

levels.label: unblended (3rd)
levels.description: you relate to feelings with curiosity and distance, as a part you're with rather than a part you are

levels.label: moderate
levels.description: some discomfort, can be mitigated with sufficient care
